headline: LAD @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 3.86 at LAA 3.23, with a projected total of 7.09. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAD moved -1.22 runs while LAA moved +0.25, changing the projected margin by -1.47 runs. The projected total fell -0.96, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Jack Kochanowicz has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Nolan Schanuel, Freddie Freeman, Kyle Tucker, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Sebastián Rivero, Miguel Rojas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
